name: PPL Electric Utilities
notes: OMAP platform (same as Rhode Island Energy). Public map host outagemap.pplelectric.com is a CNAME to omap.prod.pplweb.com and fails TLS name check in Chrome; the pplweb host serves the same API with a valid cert. Each county row also has a mun[] list of municipalities. Tabular list can omit counties with no outages, so no servedField is set; totalPath nc is the published total.

name: Rhode Island Energy (Narragansett Electric)
notes: Narragansett is now Rhode Island Energy (PPL). Same OMAP platform as PPL; counties Bristol, Kent, Newport, Providence, Washington. Tabular list can omit counties with no outages, so no servedField is set; totalPath nc is the published total.

name: NYSEG

custom.requiresHeader: Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key (value is embedded in the portal JS; not recorded here)
custom.needed: A json adapter with a header supplied by the lead, if approved. listPath features, areaField properties.county (filter by properties.level=county), outField properties.Outages, servedField properties.customers; totals at top level (customers, outages).

notes: embedded-key: Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key header on apim.avangrid.com (also an Authorization Basic header on some portal calls). County-level feed exists. Avangrid is also an ODIN reporter (EIA 14349 AVANGRID).

name: United Illuminating

custom.responseSample: ~500 KB JS holding a FocalPoint (Ventyx) mapConfig with one overlay per town (Ansonia, Bridgeport, Derby, East Haven, Easton, Fairfield, Hamden, Milford, New Haven, North Branford, North Haven, Orange, Shelton, Stratford, Trumbull, West Haven, Woodbridge). Per-town status is an HTML label such as 'No current outages' plus a targetVal; no JSON endpoint.
custom.needed: A regex/parse adapter over GEMap1.js targetVal per overlay; unverified because every town showed No current outages when checked.

notes: No JSON feed found: static FocalPoint map page. Avangrid is an ODIN reporter (EIA 14349) which may cover UI.

name: Unitil (Unitil Energy Systems NH, Fitchburg Gas & Electric MA)

custom.response: HTTP 420 with no body to the harness
custom.needed: Siena Technologies webmaps API; data endpoint not seen because the token request failed. Needs review.

notes: One Unitil map for both NH and MA (Fitchburg) territories. Vendor Siena Technologies; token flow not replayed.

name: UGI Utilities (electric)

custom.responseSample: The page HTML embeds the outage list as an inline script variable: 'var outages = [];' (empty when checked), consumed by /wp-content/plugins/ugi-outages-map/public/js/outages.min.js together with a municipalities list.
custom.needed: A regex adapter over the inline outages array; unverifiable while it is empty.

notes: Customers-affected counts are in the page-embedded array, updated every 15 minutes per the page.
